sources.title: HarmonyOS business-module development contract supplied in task context
claims: Business modules use MVVM and State Management V2.
Network access belongs under the business module api directory.
UI artifacts are classified as components, dialogs, and pages.
Shell-project delegate content and business routing metadata have dedicated directories.
An optional xxxprovider module is the sole external bridge and declares service and component contracts implemented by xxx.

sources.title: drill-hm features/ugc and provider/ugcprovider architecture
claims: The exemplar separates api, components, dialogs, pages, models, uistate, viewmodels, router, hmrouter, and shell delegate code.
ViewModels and mutable UI models use ObservedV2 with traced properties.
Network repository interfaces, implementations, endpoints, and services remain under api.
The provider HAR declares an external router interface and service key while the business HAR implements the interface.
